verdicts.reason: Both are unusable: the forest background was not extended, so it sits as a narrow centre strip. Text that falls outside the strip is white or cream on white and can't be seen. A clips the headline into 'cial Even / Internat / of For', leaves 'March 21' as unreadable cream on white, and cuts off the subtitle. B is worse: only 'oted / Day' survives of the headline, the subtitle, quote and URL are cut off at the strip's right edge, and the divider rules float on white. A is picked only because more of its headline is still visible on the green.
